tree.heading: Definition of United States Segment of the International Space Station.—
tree.text: In this section the term “United States segment of the International Space Station” means those elements of the International Space Station manufactured—

children.text: for the United States by other nations in exchange for funds or launch services.

tree.heading: Designation.—
tree.text: To further the policy described in section 70501(a) of this title, the United States segment of the International Space Station is hereby designated a national laboratory.

children.heading: Partnerships.—
children.text: The Administrator shall seek to increase the utilization of the International Space Station by other Federal entities and the private sector through partnerships, cost-sharing agreements, and other arrangements that would supplement Administration funding of the International Space Station.

children.heading: Contracting.—
children.text: The Administrator may enter into a contract with a nongovernmental entity to operate the International Space Station national laboratory, subject to all applicable Federal laws and regulations.
